Results.ReviewText:
Loving this grill 
I considered cheaper options, but finally decided the upgrade in construction was worth the price — so glad I did. To be fair, my Kenmore grill lasted 15 years. I did replace grates and heat reflectors, but overall it served me well. But this grill, though smaller, seems like a big upgrade. I didn’t opt for the “sear zone”, but I don’t eat red meat, so didn’t think my salmon and tofu needed the boost. This 3 burner model provides nice grill marks, easy clean up, and no sticking to grills.
Results.Title: Excellent in every way

Results.ReviewText: In general, I like the new grille after my almost 20 year old Genesis 3 burner gave up the ghost. The new grille works as advertised but I do not like the inside cabinet storage for the propane tank. Very awkward for changing tanks and even just turning it on for older adult. The tank weight scale on my old Genesis never really worked correctly so I don’t miss that but still would have preferred external tank mount and a bit more room to turn valve and change out. Right side table also seems a bit flimsy and not supported fully. Have no idea how easy or hard it will be to replace parts, especially the built-in igniters.
Results.Title: New Spirit Grille Comments

Results.ReviewText: Good so far! I had the call Weber because the lighting instructions didn’t work.  Once depressed the grill wouldn’t stay lit when I let go of button.  Read and reread instructions etc.  the agent was very helpful with a reverse camera app.  The instructions she gave were not anything like what was in manual.  She said it was new method this year.  Why not have manual rewriting taking the frustration out of process.

Results.ReviewText: Heats up very quickly, nice surface area, love that the ignition is built into the burner off and on switch.   Only reservation is that it is difficult to move around, with wheels only on one side and locked in one direction. I can live with this as it is a great barbecue.

Results.ReviewText: An excellent smaller grill that is perfect for a couple or small BBQ gatherings. Assembly was straightforward and the instructions reasonably clear. A second person is helpful at a couple steps. Grill is very sturdy and seems durable. Grates are heavy duty. The sear zone works great for steaks and chops. I’ve owned 4-5 Weber grills and generally get 10+ years out of them because of the design, quality materials, and parts availability. The one time I tried a competitive brand I had to replace grates and other parts too frequently, it was harder to clean, and was entering end of life in about 6 years.

Temperatures vary but easy enough to adjust for different dishes once you have used it couple of times. We got the grill accessories to go with it and are glad we did. Glad we purchased it instead of a larger one.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We never want to disappoint one of our loyal Weber grillers, and we are very sorry to have lost your trust. We wish we could have helped improve your experience before the grills were returned, and we hope you'll consider us again in the future.
Our grills have a built-in safety feature that limits gas flow. Sometimes this creates difficulty with ignition, but it can be easily resolved.
If you are experiencing ignition issues, here's what to do:
Perform a soapy water leak test. If there is no leak, follow these instructions to light your grill every time you use it:
Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60-90 seconds - This is the MOST important part. This allows the safety feature in your grill's regulator to determine there is no leak in the gas line. 
Turn light the first burner and leave it on high
Turn on remaining burners one at a time and set each to high
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 450°F
After grilling, always turn the propane tank OFF.

Results.ReviewText: We went to Lowe’s to replace our 15+ Genesis grill by Weber. We did not need a big grill so we decided to get the E-325 Gas grill. I registered the grill but I got a continual denial indicating that I was putting the wrong serial number. I’m talking resubmitting 5x at least. Finally, I contacted customer service via email. Their response was that they registered the grill for me. That’s all they said - they registered it for me. The first time to start/light, it fired right up. But, it did not stay lit. Frustrating. All 3 burners lit but none stayed lit. Customer service was called. I was asked to give the serial number of the grill. I explained what had happened in my initial attempt to register this but I felt I was not being heard. A language barrier ? Anyhow, I was asked to provide a picture of the serial number and send the pic via email. After (10) min of email it was established that this serial number did not exist. After 25-30 minute exchange of information to establish my identity, my address, my email and faulty serial number we finally got to the issue. I was told I had a faulty magneto and that a part would be sent. In the meantime, manual lighting would have to be used but that still did not keep the burners lit. This phone call was 15 June. I called back 24 June to get an order update. I was informed that there was no part on the way. Did I misunderstand via another language barrier that I was told no part was on the way ?  She knew what part I needed was the most frustrating part. I told her that I would be taking this grill back to Lowe’s for a refund, which I did. The one thing besides a working grill that I’m disappointed in is that there isn’t a gauge where to hang the propane tank and the volume can be monitored for capacity and not have to guess.
Results.Title: Unbelievable

Results.ReviewText: Love my Weber E325 gas grill! It is the perfect size for my location. Cooks evenly and the sear zone is amazing! Best looking and best tasting ribeyes I ever cooked!. The quality of the grill is what you expect from Weber!

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased the Spirit E-325 grill to replace an older Spirit 325.  The new model is not as well built, lacks a back panel, has only two wheels so it can't be pulled forward, replaces chrome side tables with plastic and does not have a tank hanger/gauge.  And, the burner area is smaller than the old model although both have three burners.
My biggest issue is that it is harder to start.  If you open the tank valve too fast, the regulator jams up.  After slowly opening the tank, if you do not then hold the burner knob for a few seconds after the click, it does not light.  The old system was simply to open the tank and push the electric lighter.  Not an improvement.
The sear zone burners do get very hot though.

Definitely not an upgrade to the old model.
Results.Title: Hard To Start
